about: The only licence_class strings the outline store writes. publishable can be true only for a class marked can_be_publishable, and only with publish_basis verified-row (a verified-layers.csv row with an evidence URL) or owner-confirmed (the owner recorded the licence).

OPEN.meaning: a named open licence that is not share-alike (CC BY, CC0, OGL, Licence Ouverte, dl-de/by, NLOD ...)

PUBLIC DOMAIN.meaning: public domain, stated by the agency

NO TERMS STATED.meaning: a public government layer with no terms posted (owner rule 3: credit the agency, take down on request)

DISCLAIMER ONLY.meaning: only a no-warranty disclaimer, no use terms (treated like NO TERMS STATED)

NON-COMMERCIAL.meaning: a non-commercial licence without a ban on redistribution (owner decision 2)

SHARE-ALIKE.meaning: CC BY-SA / ODbL / other share-alike: NOT publishable until the owner decides on share-alike

RESTRICTED IN WRITING.meaning: written terms forbid redistribution or copying

DO NOT SHARE.meaning: the owner read the page: do not share / no redistribution / private use

PRIVATE UNTIL LICENCE READ.meaning: no licence recorded by a person yet (the default)
